decisions: Link prediction uses explainable common-neighbor Jaccard scoring over the weak graph.
Existing links and self-links are excluded; candidates are sorted by descending score then destination id.
Both LinkPredictionInterface and LinkPredictor are exported to keep the public interface explicit and ergonomic.
risks: The interface is unweighted and relation-agnostic; relation-specific or learned embeddings are outside P06-T07.
Unknown source ids return no candidates rather than creating a node implicitly.
follow_up: BF-P00-T06 golden validation in an isolated copy; do not overwrite live tracked artifacts
